task: Implement the Proof-or-Stop Evidence Environment Adapter contract, reference paths, admissibility integration, lifecycle Gate consumption, and an auditable paper-facing description.
outcome: The user runs npm --prefix packages/main run test:evidence-environment-adapter and sees evidence environment adapter smoke passed. Documentation states that Proof-or-Stop implements the generic EEA contract, code-runtime local receipt projection, Quantum receipt-only projection, and DONE_REQUIRED Gate consumption, while Lean, Rosetta, AlphaFold, and other external environments remain integration targets.
facts: Proof Admissibility already owns proof-surface, claim, consumer, and producer-boundary semantics.
ClaimAdmissibilityPack already declares code-runtime and Quantum verifier adapters; Quantum is receipt-only.
The local reference path reuses DONE-required receipts and command identity from the policy-authorized validation executor; it adds no launcher.
Gate integration reuses the done-required-evidence proof surface and DONE_REQUIRED consumer rather than creating a parallel lifecycle Gate.
The audited execution plan defines milestones M0 through M6 and six safety invariants.
constraints: An adapter may produce observations or receipts but cannot decide Done or mutate lifecycle state.
Every Gate-consumed fact must be registered in the process-fact registry.
Caller-provided host or provider strings cannot establish independent producers or quorum.
External or remote receipts without verifiable attestation must fail closed; distinct-host quorum remains unsupported until a pinned cryptographic registry exists.
Existing code-runtime and Quantum Pack behavior must remain backward compatible.
Do not implement or claim Lean, Rosetta, AlphaFold, PINN solver, or other target adapters.
